sloka: सभाग्यश्चासि धर्मज्ञ राम सत्यपराक्रम ।लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा समरे रिपुघातिना ।। ६.५०.५० ।।।।
transliteration: sabhāgyaścāsi dharmajña rāma satyaparākrama ।lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā samare ripughātinā ।। 6.50.50 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are lucky and also Lakshmana your brother, destroyer of foes in war. Rama your strength is truth, and you are righteous."
